name: Beyond unhinged
source:
You find yourself in an orgy in a not so far future. Everything suddenly changes into abnormal horror. Can you and how you survive this bizarre reality?

[From [url=https://trc450.itch.io/beyond-unhinged]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你发现自己身处不远未来的一场群交中，情势却突然变成了异常恐怖的局面。你能在这诡异的现实中活下来吗？又该如何逃生？

[引自[url=https://trc450.itch.io/beyond-unhinged]Itch.io[/url]]
